packageRules.description: Track plugin-barman-cloud chart and flag the TLS cert workaround
prBodyNotes: :warning: This repo carries a workaround for cloudnative-pg/charts#781 (broken chart TLS certs on cert-manager >= 1.18): `certificate.createServerCertificate`/`createClientCertificate` are set to `false` in the HelmRelease and the server/client certs are self-managed in `apps/cnpg/barman/certificates/` (reconciled by the `cnpg-barman-certs` Kustomization).

Before merging, check whether this release fixes #781 or wires `certificate.issuerName` (PR #811). If so, you can point `issuerName` at `barman-cloud-ca-issuer` (or re-enable the chart certs) and remove the `certificates/` directory and the `cnpg-barman-certs` Kustomization.

packageRules.description: Substrate stack must upgrade in lockstep — never automerge. Pinned <0.0.22: 0.0.22+ re-architected the control plane (mTLS pod-identity only, WorkerPool ateomImage->workerImage, SandboxConfig spec.default removed) and no kagent stable speaks it — kagent 0.10.x vendors substrate v0.0.9 (jwt/insecure client), only kagent 1.0.0-alpha pairs (vendors v0.3.0-alpha3). Re-attempted 0.0.30 via #499, reverted, see #553. Unpin when kagent 1.0.0 stable lands, then upgrade kagent+substrate as a pair.
prBodyNotes: :warning: PINNED at 0.0.21 — do not merge bumps to >=0.0.22 (see #553 and the rule description). The 0.0.30 control plane drops the jwt client mode the digest-pinned ateapi fork and kagent 0.10.x rely on: ate-api-server is mTLS-only (PodCertificate cred bundle + authentication-config), CRDs renamed WorkerPool.spec.ateomImage -> workerImage and removed SandboxConfig.spec.default, and the chart ships its own gvisor-default SandboxConfig (conflicts with the git-managed one; its gs:// asset URL is unreachable from this cluster). Historical checklist for a paired kagent 1.0.0 + substrate >=0.3.0 upgrade: rebase or drop the ateapi fork (its --client-jwt-jwks-url flags no longer exist upstream), work around the Role hardcoded to the ate-system namespace, keep spec.pauseImage at sha256:bcbd57ba... (matches existing actor snapshots), and decide the worker pod-identity story.

packageRules.description: Track floating tags by digest. Tags like latest/edge/main are not versions, so Renovate skips them as invalid-value; pinning the digest lets it raise update PRs when the tag is rebuilt. (nsyncd is also semver-tracked; the digest pin just adds rebuild-level updates.)
